<style>
/* ── Hero dark background (pure CSS — bypasses Tailwind version issues) ── */
.hero-dark-bg {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #020617 0%, #0f172a 50%, #020617 100%);
}

/* ── Hero ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.hero-grid-bg {
    background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(34,197,94,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,197,94,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 48px 48px;
}
.particle {
    position: absolute;
    width: 4px; height: 4px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(34,197,94,0.5);
    animation: particle-drift linear infinite;
}
@keyframes particle-drift {
    0%   { transform: translateY(0) translateX(0);   opacity: 0; }
    10%  { opacity: 1; }
    90%  { opacity: 0.6; }
    100% { transform: translateY(-120px) translateX(30px); opacity: 0; }
}

/* Typewriter cursor */
#typewriter-word::after {
    content: '|';
    animation: cur-blink 1s step-end infinite;
    color: #22c55e;
    margin-inline-start: 2px;
}
@keyframes cur-blink { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0} }

/* Badge pulse rings */
.badge-ring {
    animation: badge-pulse 2.5s ease-out infinite;
}
.badge-ring-2 {
    animation: badge-pulse 2.5s ease-out 0.8s infinite;
}
@keyframes badge-pulse {
    0%   { transform: scale(1);   opacity: 0.6; }
    100% { transform: scale(2.2); opacity: 0; }
}

/* Scroll indicator bounce */
.scroll-indicator {
    animation: bounce-y 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes bounce-y {
    0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); }
    50%     { transform: translateY(10px); }
}

/* ── Terminal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.terminal-glow {
    transition: box-shadow 0.4s ease;
}
.terminal-glow:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(34,197,94,0.3), 0 20px 60px rgba(34,197,94,0.12);
}
.traffic-red    { background: #ff5f56; }
.traffic-yellow { background: #ffbd2e; }
.traffic-green  { background: #27c93f; }

/* ── Stats shimmer border ──────────────────────────────────────── */
.stat-card {
    transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}
.stat-card:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(34,197,94,0.4), 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    transform: translateY(-3px);
}

/* ── How It Works connector ───────────────────────────────────── */
.step-connector {
    height: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #16a34a, #22c55e);
    width: 0%;
    transition: width 1.2s ease 0.4s;
}
.step-connector.drawn { width: 100%; }

/* ── Step circle dash animation ───────────────────────────────── */
.step-circle-svg circle {
    stroke-dasharray: 88;
    stroke-dashoffset: 88;
    transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.8s ease;
}
.step-visible .step-circle-svg circle {
    stroke-dashoffset: 0;
}

/* ── Pricing glow ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.pricing-popular-glow {
    animation: pricing-glow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes pricing-glow {
    0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(22,163,74,0.25), 0 0 0 2px #16a34a; }
    50%     { box-shadow: 0 0 35px rgba(22,163,74,0.5),  0 0 0 2px #22c55e; }
}
.pricing-card {
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}
.pricing-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-8px);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
}
.pricing-card:hover .price-num {
    transform: scale(1.06);
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
}

/* ── CTA animated gradient ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.cta-bg {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a, #16a34a, #0f172a, #15803d);
    background-size: 300% 300%;
    animation: cta-gradient 8s ease infinite;
}
@keyframes cta-gradient {
    0%,100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
    50%     { background-position: 100% 50%; }
}

/* Ripple button */
.ripple-btn {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.ripple-btn .ripple-effect {
    position: absolute;
    border-radius: 50%;
    transform: scale(0);
    animation: ripple-anim 0.6s linear;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    pointer-events: none;
}
@keyframes ripple-anim {
    to { transform: scale(4); opacity: 0; }
}

/* ── Responsive stagger delays ─────────────────────────────────── */
.delay-100 { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
.delay-200 { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
.delay-300 { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
.delay-400 { transition-delay: 0.4s; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .particle, .badge-ring, .badge-ring-2, .scroll-indicator,
    .cta-bg, #typewriter-word::after { animation: none !important; }
    .step-connector { width: 100% !important; transition: none !important; }
}

<script>
(function () {

// ── Floating particles ─────────────────────────────────────────────
const pContainer = document.getElementById('particles-container');
if (pContainer) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
        const dot = document.createElement('div');
        dot.className = 'particle';
        dot.style.left   = (Math.random() * 100) + '%';
        dot.style.bottom = (Math.random() * 20) + '%';
        dot.style.width  = dot.style.height = (2 + Math.random() * 3) + 'px';
        dot.style.animationDuration  = (5 + Math.random() * 8) + 's';
        dot.style.animationDelay     = (Math.random() * 6) + 's';
        dot.style.opacity = 0;
        pContainer.appendChild(dot);
    }
}

// ── Typewriter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const words = [
    'WhatsApp OTP',
    'SMS Verification',
    'API Integration',
];
const twEl = document.getElementById('typewriter-word');
if (twEl) {
    let wIdx = 0, cIdx = 0, deleting = false;
    function type() {
        const word = words[wIdx];
        if (!deleting) {
            twEl.textContent = word.slice(0, ++cIdx);
            if (cIdx === word.length) {
                deleting = true;
                setTimeout(type, 2200);
                return;
            }
        } else {
            twEl.textContent = word.slice(0, --cIdx);
            if (cIdx === 0) {
                deleting = false;
                wIdx = (wIdx + 1) % words.length;
            }
        }
        setTimeout(type, deleting ? 55 : 110);
    }
    setTimeout(type, 800);
}

// ── Terminal typewriter ────────────────────────────────────────────
const terminalLines = [
    { text: '# Send OTP via WhatsApp',    color: '#64748b', delay: 0 },
    { text: 'curl -X POST https://myotpway.online/api/v1/otp/send \\', color: '#60a5fa', delay: 400 },
    { text: '  -H "X-API-Key: sk_live_xxxx" \\',  color: '#f8fafc', delay: 800 },
    { text: '  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\', color: '#f8fafc', delay: 1100 },
    { text: "  -d '{\"to\":\"+9647XXXXXXXXX\",\"template\":\"myotp_default\"}'", color: '#fbbf24', delay: 1400 },
];
const termOut = document.getElementById('terminal-output');
const termResp = document.getElementById('terminal-response');

function typeTermLine(line, callback) {
    const p = document.createElement('p');
    p.style.color = line.color;
    p.style.minHeight = '1.4em';
    termOut.appendChild(p);
    let i = 0;
    function tick() {
        if (i <= line.text.length) {
            p.textContent = line.text.slice(0, i++);
            setTimeout(tick, 18);
        } else if (callback) {
            callback();
        }
    }
    setTimeout(tick, line.delay);
}

if (termOut) {
    let idx = 0;
    function runNextLine() {
        if (idx < terminalLines.length) {
            const line = terminalLines[idx++];
            typeTermLine(line, runNextLine);
        } else {
            // Show response after last line
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (termResp) termResp.style.opacity = '1';
            }, 600);
        }
    }

    // Start terminal when it enters view
    const termObs = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(e => {
            if (e.isIntersecting && idx === 0) {
                runNextLine();
                termObs.unobserve(e.target);
            }
        });
    }, { threshold: 0.3 });
    const termSection = termOut.closest('section');
    if (termSection) termObs.observe(termSection);
}

// ── Counter animation ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function animateCounter(el, target, decimal, prefix, suffix) {
    const startTime = performance.now();
    const duration = 1800;
    function update(now) {
        const p = Math.min((now - startTime) / duration, 1);
        const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
        const val = ease * target;
        el.textContent = prefix + (decimal > 0 ? val.toFixed(decimal) : Math.floor(val).toLocaleString('en-US')) + suffix;
        if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(update);
        else el.textContent = prefix + (decimal > 0 ? target.toFixed(decimal) : target.toLocaleString('en-US')) + suffix;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(update);
}

const counterObs = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(e => {
        if (!e.isIntersecting) return;
        const el = e.target;
        const target  = parseFloat(el.dataset.target);
        const decimal = parseInt(el.dataset.decimal) || 0;
        const prefix  = el.dataset.prefix || '';
        const suffix  = el.dataset.suffix || '';
        animateCounter(el, target, decimal, prefix, suffix);
        counterObs.unobserve(el);
    });
}, { threshold: 0.5 });
document.querySelectorAll('.stat-counter').forEach(el => counterObs.observe(el));

// ── How It Works: connector + step circles ─────────────────────────
const connectorObs = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(e => {
        if (e.isIntersecting) {
            const conn = document.getElementById('step-connector');
            if (conn) conn.classList.add('drawn');
            document.querySelectorAll('.step-item').forEach(item => item.classList.add('step-visible'));
            connectorObs.unobserve(e.target);
        }
    });
}, { threshold: 0.2 });
const howSection = document.getElementById('how-it-works');
if (howSection) connectorObs.observe(howSection);

// ── Ripple effect ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.addRipple = function(e, btn) {
    const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
    const size = Math.max(rect.width, rect.height) * 2;
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left - size / 2;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top  - size / 2;
    const ripple = document.createElement('span');
    ripple.className = 'ripple-effect';
    ripple.style.cssText = 'width:' + size + 'px;height:' + size + 'px;left:' + x + 'px;top:' + y + 'px;';
    btn.appendChild(ripple);
    ripple.addEventListener('animationend', () => ripple.remove());
};

})();

function toggleMobileMenu() {

    else openMobileMenu();
}
function openMobileMenu() {
    document.getElementById('mobile-overlay').classList.add('open');

    const lines = document.querySelectorAll('.ham-line');

function closeMobileMenu() {

    const lines = document.querySelectorAll('.ham-line');
    if (lines[0]) lines[0].style.transform = '';

(function() {
    if (!window.IntersectionObserver) return;
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                entry.target.classList.add('animate-in');
                obs.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
        });
    }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-animate]').forEach(el => obs.observe(el));
})();
